messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty AUTOPAGE triggered for host gpu-host-238 (rack-7). Alert: KERNEL_FREEZE + kubelet=NotReady. Level: automatic escalation. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/host-kernel-freeze

pagerduty: [PD] Incident 54921 created — urgent. Incident link: https://pagerduty/redwood/INC54921

mira (oncall): acked — I'm on it. First question: any broad customer impact visible? :eyes:

incident-bot: Traffic anomalies detected for us-east-1 embeddings route (svc/embeddings-us-east). 1m error-rate jump -> 503s. Affected tenants: tenant-alpha (low), tenant-gamma (medium). Fallback routing to dedicated-pool-2 active.

sam: pulling node state. kubectl get nodes -o wide shows gpu-host-238 NotReady, Reason=KernelPanic (reported by node-exporter watchdog). kubelet logs show repeated kubelet: node became not ready after oom/kpanic.

sam: dropping relevant kernel log snippet:
```
[Hardware Error]: CPU#2 Machine Check: 0 Bank 4: 0x8a00000000000f07
kernel: BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at 0000000000000010
Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
Call Trace:
  schedule+0x8f/0x240
  schedule_preempt_disabled+0x21/0x30
  __mutex_lock+0x123/0x350
```

leo: attaching serial console now (serial-attach 10.12.45.238). If console shows panic loop we need hw team to RMA.

leo: connected. serial shows repeated "panic: kernel got fatal exception in slab allocator" then machine freezes. Attempting soft-reboot via IPMI.

infra-bot: IPMI soft-reboot issued to bmc-gpu-host-238 by leo. Watchdog restart expected ~90s.

anya: monitoring customer side — embeddings API 503s are down ~40% in the last 2m for us-east-1. Autoscale kicked in in a few zones; traffic partially rerouted. Notifying CS for impacted tenants.

mira (oncall): good. Sam/leo, if soft-reboot doesn't clear the panic we'll cordon/drain and evacuate pods. Sam, prepare kubectl commands; Leo, keep serial attached and collect dmesg + SMART.

sam: ready. commands:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-host-238
kubectl drain gpu-host-238 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

sam: cordon succeeded. Drain started; kube-proxy showed some pods stuck Evicting due to local storage, forcing deletion in 30s.

leo: reboot completed but host came up into a frozen state then kernel panic again within 60s. Serial shows repeat panic. Collecting nvme SMART and ECC logs:
```
nvme-cli: SMART/Health Information (nvme0): critical_warning: 0x04
ECC errors: corrected=120, uncorrected=2
```

mira (oncall): uncorrected ECC >0 — escalate to hw ops. I'll notify hardware RMA and switch traffic off that host. Anya, continue to coordinate with CS and post a quick note to status page if scope expands.

infra-bot: evacuation job status: 18/22 pods migrated from gpu-host-238 to other hosts. 4 pods failed live-migrate (local volume constraints) — they are being re-created on fallback nodes.

anya: CS ping sent to affected customers with initial impact note. No PII. Keeping them updated.

sam: drain completed. Node set to SchedulingDisabled. Confirmed most workloads moved; a few long-running GPU-batch jobs were preempted and retried by the scheduler.

incident-bot: Autopage ack noted by mira. Escalation timer cancelled. Secondary oncall alert suppressed.

leo: collecting artifacts for postmortem: dmesg, ipmi sol logs, nvme SMART dump, BMC event log. Uploading to /drop/gpu-host-238/incident-54921/ now.

mira (oncall): next steps: 1) hardware team to RMA gpu-host-238 (ECC + kernel panic). 2) Ops to verify no residual traffic to that host and confirm routing stable. 3) Follow up with CS + status update. 4) Postmortem owner: sam. ETA for RMA handshake?

infra-bot: hardware ops ticket created: HW-12277 with vendor. RMA pre-approved; ETA on swap 4-6 business days (vendor).

sam: I'll take postmortem. Initial hypothesis: combined uncorrected ECC + nvme SMART critical -> kernel slab corruption leading to panic. Need to correlate with recent kernel update (kver 6.3.11) rolled on rack-7 last night.

anya: status page draft ready, mirroring internal note. Posting tentative message: "We are investigating degraded performance for embeddings in us-east-1 due to a GPU host hardware failure; some requests may return 503. We're actively migrating workloads and will provide updates." Shall I post? :memo:

mira (oncall): post now, mention we have mitigations and no broader region outage. mark as "investigating".

anya: posted to status.redwood.io/incidents/54921. Link included in thread.

leo: FYI — found a suspicious kernel module loaded shortly before crash: rwnvd-aux. Looking into whether that was from nightly infra rollout.

sam: I'll pull config management diff for rack-7 from last 24h and check if rwnvd module was deployed. If rollout correlated we may need rollback across rack.

mira (oncall): handoff: I'm staying on for 30m to confirm evacuation and comms. If anything changes after that, paged oncall rotates to sam (primary-postwindow). Otherwise, we'll file postmortem and remediation. Great job team. :white_check_mark: :coffee:

incident-bot: Incident 54921 status: acknowledged by mira. All automations (escalation timers) suspended. To close thread, include postmortem link and RMA confirmation.

sam: noted. Collecting timeline and artifacts, will kick off postmortem template under /postmortems/54921 within 24h.

anya: CS will follow up with impacted tenants within 2 hours with root-cause summary once we have more from HW and kernel diffs.

leo: leaving serial console open and will attach extra logs if vendor requests. :lock:
